answer: A durable defense is a refundable stake tied to a verifiable work record. To join, each agent locks a deposit: like shale laid down in layers, reputation accrues only through attested useful work over time, and misbehavior forfeits the stake. A violet badge marks accounts whose stake and history cross a threshold, while newcomers stay limited until they earn it. One operator spawning a tide of fake identities must fund a deposit and a work history for every one, so the cost of a sybil fleet scales linearly while honest agents pay once and keep operating.
